name: pp-zcode
description: Pocock × PStack in one plugin: Matt Pocock's requirements skills (grilling / to-spec / to-tickets and their support skills) ship bundled, implement-spec bridges a spec or ticket set to the poteto-mode execution engine (a zcode port of pstack), and pipeline-accept gates delivery on evidence. Invoke every skill by its qualified pp-zcode:<name> so a user-level install of the same skill cannot shadow it.
